title: Concept: Handlebars template error returned to a client
description: A Handlebars template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The parse error prints the template name and the offset, which reveals the server-side rendering path behind the page.
applicability: Deployments that render a Handlebars template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The parse error prints the template name and the offset, which reveals the server-side rendering path behind the page.
